gauge.name: Tallapoosa River at Milstead

impacts.statement: Water overflows the yards of some homes in the Milstead area.
Flooding of some roads in the area begins.
Extensive flooding of pasture lands in the area occurs.
Considerable low land flooding occurs. Livestock should be moved to higher ground.
Overflow of pasture lands occurs. Cattle may need to be moved if higher stages are forecast.

hydronotes.statement: River forecasts for this location take into account past precipitation and the precipitation amounts expected approximately 48 hours into the future from the forecast issuance time.

gauge.forecastReliability: Forecasts are issued as needed during times of high water, but are not routinely available.
